description: UserPromptSubmit hook: gives gentle, non-blocking English hints on the natural-language part of each prompt (ignores code/commands/paths) and remembers recurring mistakes in a per-user ledger. Registered with asyncRewake so Claude Code runs the model call in the background and wakes Claude to post the hint as soon as it's ready, even mid-idle — the hook itself never blocks or slows a turn. Requires the `claude` CLI and `jq`; degrades to a no-op if either is missing.
